log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Garchomp

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Charizard Y. Charizard-Venusaur establishes sun immediately: Chlorophyll gives Venusaur control to Sleep Powder disruptive partners or Sludge Bomb Floette, while Heat Wave pressures both slots. Scarf Garchomp supplies Rock/Ground and Dragon pressure for Arcanine-Hisui and Dragapult; Primarina is the reliable Basculegion and Fairy endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster confirms Floettite Floette, Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion, Friend Guard Maushold, Choice Scarf Timid Dragapult, Leftovers Annihilape, and Intimidate Hard Stone Hisuian Arcanine. Preserve the Charizard Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur mode as primary; respect Follow Me/Friend Guard when trying to remove Floette. Primarina is valuable into Basculegion and Floette; Scarf Garchomp pressures Dragapult and Arcanine-Hisui.

decisions.rationale: Mega Floette. Lead Arcanine+Bascu: Intimidate+Rock Slide/Wave Crash immediately punish ZardY/Venusaur sun cores. Back Mega Floette+Maushold: Friend Guard blunts Heat Wave, Follow Me enables Light of Ruin; Floette answers Chomp/Dragons. Cut ScarfPult/Ape for sun bulk this game.
decisions.notebook: Plan: Opp Mega ZardY Drought + Chomp/Chlorophyll/support. Answer: Intimidate H-Arcanine Rock Slide + Bascu Adapt Water pressure Fire/Flying; FG Maushold blunt Heat Wave + PBomb; Mega Floette (+Dragapult when brought) delete Chomp/H-Goodra; Ape late Rage Fist cleaner. Registered sets unchanged. G1 bring Arcanine+Bascu+Floette+Maushold; adjust G2 if Chomp/Goodra dominate.

decisions.rationale: Mega Protect prevents the immediate 4x-effective Rock Slide while Drought activates Chlorophyll, guaranteeing Venusaur moves before Arcanine. Sleep Powder on Arcanine removes the main Charizard threat; Basculegion's Water attacks are weakened by sun and resisted by Venusaur. This also covers Basculegion Protect better than committing Charizard to Solar Beam.
decisions.notebook: Primary mode remains Mega Charizard Y plus Chlorophyll Venusaur. Against Hisuian Arcanine + Basculegion, respect Rock Slide into Charizard; use Mega Protect/Sleep Powder lines when needed to establish control. Sun weakens Basculegion Water pressure and enables immediate Solar Beam.

decisions.rationale: Sun+Chloro lets Venu outspeed and OHKO Bascu with LO SolarBeam; Protect blanks that and Sleep. Hard Stone RS guarantees Zard OHKO (4x) even spread if we win speed or they attack; chips Venu. FB Venu is only a range and leaves Zard free.

Venusaur is guaranteed to act before Charizard and can remove Arcanine’s Rock Slide threat if Sleep Powder connects. Charizard’s Solar Beam is a guaranteed OHKO on Basculegion if it does not land its reduced-success consecutive Protect. This maximizes the immediate chance to remove Basculegion while preserving Charizard.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Arcanine-Hisui has Intimidate, Rock Slide, Flare Blitz, ExtremeSpeed, and Protect; Basculegion has Life Orb, Adaptability, Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, and Protect. Both revealed Protect. Primary Charizard-Y/Venusaur sun mode remains preferred; prioritize Sleep Powder on Arcanine when Charizard is exposed to Rock Slide, then use sun-enabled Solar Beam to remove Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Aqua Jet +1 chips Zard before Venu Solars Bascu; Arc Rock Slide then KOs Zard (4x Hard Stone, ends Drought) and 28-52% Venu from 49% (often KO). Arc lives any Zard reply. Removes sun + both threats for Bascu.
Arcanine slp needs FG blunt on sun spread/SE hits; Maushold FollowMe + Sitrus enables wake and Extreme Speed/Rock Slide cleanup vs 52/49 ZardVenu. Floette dies to sun offense without support.

Protect denies the immediate Rock Slide loss if Arcanine wakes. Sleep Powder aimed at Maushold either lands directly or is naturally supported by Follow Me redirecting it onto Maushold; this removes redirection while preserving both attackers. Maushold Protect is the main adverse line, but Charizard remains safe.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Arcanine-Hisui has Intimidate, Rock Slide, Flare Blitz, ExtremeSpeed, and Protect; Basculegion has Life Orb, Adaptability, Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, and Protect. Both revealed Protect. Primary Charizard-Y/Venusaur sun mode remains preferred; prioritize Sleep Powder on Arcanine when Charizard is exposed to Rock Slide, then use sun-enabled Solar Beam to remove Basculegion. Maushold revealed Follow Me, Population Bomb, Tidy Up, Protect, Sitrus Berry, and Friend Guard; respect Follow Me when selecting single-target attacks.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine asleep; Protect guarantees safety while Maushold Follow Me redirects Venusaur/Zard attacks. Friend Guard blunts spreads. Wake next turn for Rock Slide/ES pressure. Avoid free SE hits into sleep.

ZardY Modest Drought; Venu Timid LO Chlorophyll Sleep Powder; Chomp Scarf Jolly; Raichu Sash LR; H-Goodra Lefties Shell Armor; Prim Expert Belt.

decisions.rationale: Charizard cannot safely remain into a possible waking Rock Slide. Garchomp removes that 4x liability, while Venusaur Protect denies Arcanine’s possible Flare Blitz and preserves the fast sun attacker. This is safer than relying on Solar Beam through a possible Follow Me redirect.
Both asleep; Protects maximize wake chance and deny free KOs from Chlorophyll Venu/ZardY sun offense. Rock Slide/PBomb risk full sleep waste into Protect or OHKOs. Switch loses momentum vs sun.

Switching to Charizard refreshes sun and makes it immune to Garchomp’s Earthquake. Garchomp is faster than both foes at normal priority, and Earthquake has the reliable 4x KO on Arcanine while also pressuring Maushold. This avoids sacrificing Venusaur to its ally’s spread attack and preserves Charizard’s Protect for the likely Maushold retaliation.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Arcanine-Hisui: Intimidate, Rock Slide, Flare Blitz, ExtremeSpeed, Protect, Hard Stone, Adamant. Basculegion: Life Orb Adaptability with Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, Protect. Maushold: Friend Guard, Sitrus Berry, Follow Me, Population Bomb, Tidy Up, Protect; Follow Me redirects single-target attacks. Sun Charizard-Y/Venusaur mode is preferred; use sleep pressure to deny Rock Slide when Charizard is exposed. Charizard can pivot into Garchomp Earthquake safely due to Flying typing.

decisions.rationale: EQ 4x OHKOs Arc even under FG; sun Chlorophyll SolarBeam also KOs. Protect Arc; Maushold Follow Me (wake or fail) redirects both so Arc lives sun turn. Next sun ends, Floette can enter safer.

decisions.rationale: Earthquake acts before Arcanine and threatens the 4x KO while bypassing Follow Me. Protect preserves Charizard against the only immediate Rock Slide KO if Arcanine’s reduced-success Protect works; Garchomp still chips Maushold and pressures the following turn.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Chomp Scarf-locked EQ 4x Arc; Protect (even reduced) + FM redirects and Friend Guard blunts EQ on Maus while Zard is Ground-immune. Free turn to keep Arc healthy for Rock Slide pressure next. Avoid free SE hit.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Earthquake is guaranteed before Floette and hits both foes while Charizard is immune. Heat Wave then pressures both survivors through Follow Me, and the combined spread line removes Maushold while heavily pressuring Floette. If Floette Protects, Maushold still falls and Garchomp remains positioned to finish it next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Maushold has Friend Guard, Follow Me, Population Bomb, Tidy Up, Protect, consumed Sitrus; Follow Me does not stop spread attacks. Floette-Eternal has Light of Ruin, Moonblast, Giga Drain, Protect and can threaten Garchomp with Fairy damage. Against Maushold redirection, prioritize spread damage when it also advances the endgame. Garchomp Choice Scarf is faster than Floette's full revealed speed range.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Garchomp) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Scarf Chomp outspeeds Floette and EQ OHKOs Maus at 10%; Follow Me +2 redirects so Floette lives free. Mega LoR OHKOs/near-KOs Chomp (Fairy 2x). Zard Protect-reduced may attack but FM covers. Win by deleting Chomp now.

reflections.summary: Won because the Charizard-Y/Venusaur/Garchomp plan matched their redirection offense: Sleep Powder removed Arcanine and Maushold from key turns, Solar Beam immediately removed Basculegion, and Earthquake punished Follow Me while Charizard stayed immune. The selected four and Mega Charizard-Y were well suited to this matchup.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same matchup core next game, but preserve Primarina as the safer answer to Mega Floette rather than allowing Choice-locked Garchomp to be traded into Light of Ruin when a cleaner endgame is available.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leaned on Maushold Follow Me/Friend Guard support to enable Life Orb Adaptability Basculegion and Mega Floette; Maushold repeatedly used redirection and carried Sitrus Berry. Basculegion has Aqua Jet priority. Mega Floette revealed Fairy Aura and Light of Ruin, which can immediately KO Garchomp but incurs recoil. Charizard-Y/Venusaur sleep pressure plus Garchomp spread Earthquake is effective through Maushold redirection; retain Primarina as a Floette insurance piece.

reflections.summary: Lost because the G1 bring (H-Arcanine+Bascu+Maushold+Mega Floette) mismatched Drought ZardY/Venu Sleep Powder and Scarf Chomp: Bascu died to sun Solar Beam, Arc was slept then EQ-deleted, and Floette only traded Chomp via LoR recoil with no wincon left.
reflections.adjustment: Bench H-Arcanine for G2; bring Mega Floette with Maushold+Dragapult+Ape so Chomp/Goodra are answered without Arc eating Scarf EQ.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Mega ZardY Modest Drought (Protect-heavy); Venu Timid LO Chlorophyll Sleep Powder + beams; Chomp Scarf Jolly EQ-lock; Raichu Sash LR; H-Goodra Lefties Shell Armor; Prim EB Modest. Scarf EQ deletes Arc; sun beams punish Bascu. G1 Arc+Bascu bring failed into sun/sleep/Scarf Chomp. G2 plan: bench Arc; bring Mega Floette+Maushold+Dragapult+Ape (Floette deletes Chomp/H-Goodra; Ape late Rage Fist). Registered sets unchanged.
